<subject>Electronic Transactions Agreement - revised</subject>
<body>
As you’re aware, the ETA must cover TelNexus one-to-many with Maple & Crown and FiberLink one-to-many with Maple & Crown. We also require a separate TelNexus GTC one-to-many with Maple & Crown and a separate FiberLink GTC one-to-many with Maple & Crown. Additionally, we need a single OptiWave application that handles MetroNet, both one-to-many.

Please send me the drafts as soon as they’re ready—I want to review them!

Thanks.

GP
</body>

Subject: Electronic Transactions Agreement - revised

Attached is an updated version of the ETA removing the distinction between transactions on FiberLink and transactions on TelNexus. If Maple & Crown is the sole party authorized to post services on FiberLink, there’s no need for the special provisions we previously drafted for what was a "many-to-many" platform. However, we will need to create a distinct set of GTCs for transactions Maple & Crown executes on FiberLink, since the services traded there differ from those covered by Maple & Crown’s standard GTCs.
